action.mutates: on the peer: installs samba, creates the local account p8testuser (no login shell) with the fake Samba password p8test-share-not-a-secret, adds a read-only share [p8share] at /srv/p8share holding p8test-share.txt, restarts smbd

installs cifs-utils (mount.cifs, which desktop installs carry); adds the fixture sudoers drop-in /etc/sudoers.d/p8test-shares (0440) letting p8testuser run exactly the template's sudo commands (mount.cifs, umount) without a password, as a desktop user's own sudo rights would; runs the mount script as p8testuser with a wrong $PASSWORD; output in /tmp/p8test-mount-bad.out (its kdialog error dialog fails: no kdialog on GNOME)

applied.stdout:
rc 0
cifs
p8testuser 700
p8test share content
1

action.mutates: runs the mount script as p8testuser with the right $PASSWORD (its sudo mounts the share; sudo logs to the journal and /var/log/auth.log); output in /tmp/p8test-mount.out
runs the unmount script as p8testuser (its sudo unmounts the share; sudo logs to the journal and /var/log/auth.log)
